implementation_notes: Ruby has modules rather than class hierarchies, which makes composition the default: `include` a module to satisfy a role, use `Module#prepend` when you must intercept existing behaviour, and define single-method interfaces as modules. Injection is ordinary constructor parameters; `Struct` gives value semantics cheaply.
code_sketch:
module Persistable
  def save(record) = repo.put(record)
end

class OrderPublisher
  include Persistable
  def initialize(repo) = @repo = repo
end
pitfalls: Deep mixin chains create implicit method dependencies that no static tool can see (a form of hidden coupling).
`method_missing` substitutes for absent interfaces and removes any compile-time substitutability signal.
Opening classes from other modules at load time makes load order part of the design.
